Name: phase9-flink-log-discovery
Args: set -u; echo '=== YARN APPLICATIONS ==='; yarn application -list -appTypes FLINK 2>&1 || yarn application -list 2>&1 || true; echo '=== NODEMANAGER LOG DIRS ==='; yarn getconf -confKey yarn.nodemanager.log-dirs 2>&1 || true; grep -R 'yarn.nodemanager.log-dirs' /etc/hadoop/conf 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== CANDIDATE FLINK/YARN FILES ==='; sudo -n find /mnt/var/log -type f \( -iname '*flink*' -o -path '*/hadoop-yarn/containers/*' \) -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | head -n 300 || true; echo '=== FLINK PROCESS LOG PREVIEW ==='; sudo -n find /mnt/var/log -type f -iname '*flink*.log*' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | xargs -r sudo -n tail -n 40 2>&1 || true
